$comment: Infinity Mega Skill — agent bank and position-fit criteria. Each agent lists the positions it is best at; an agent is chosen for a position by the weighted score in 'positions[].weights' (see docs/INFINITY_BLUEPRINT.md). verify: docs = from the project's own docs/README; unknown = name given by the owner, not yet identified.

criteria.cost: 0 = free, 1 = free tier, 2 = cheap paid, 3 = expensive
criteria.open_source: true if source is public under an OSI licence
criteria.spawns_subagents: can create and dispatch its own sub-agents for sub-tasks
criteria.persian: quality of Persian output when backed by a good model: 0-3
criteria.tool_calling: can call tools / MCP servers reliably
criteria.iran_access: usable from Iran without a foreign card or blocked signup: yes / partial / no / unknown

agents.name: Hermes Agent (Nous Research)
agents.notes: Self-improving agent: writes its own skills, spawns sub-agents per task, works with any OpenAI-compatible model. Different from our Telegram bot in hermes/; its patterns are what hermes/ should copy.

agents.name: OpenCode
agents.notes: Terminal coding agent, any provider. Already available here as an MCP sub-agent (opencode-subagent-mcp, default DeepSeek V4.1 Flash).

agents.name: OpenClaude
agents.notes: Community Claude-Code-style CLI that talks to any OpenAI-compatible model. Repository URL to be confirmed before use.

agents.name: Claude Code
agents.notes: Architect and final reviewer; expensive, so cheap agents do the bulk and this one verifies.

agents.name: OpenDesign skills
agents.notes: motion-design, video-hyperframes, gsap-* are already installed in .claude/skills/.

agents.name: Manus
agents.notes: Closed and paid. Use its behaviour as a target for a behaviour clone (registry/behaviors/) run on free models; OpenManus is the open re-implementation.

agents.name: OpenManus
agents.notes: Open general agent modelled on Manus.

agents.name: OpenHands
agents.notes: Autonomous software agent in a sandbox.

agents.name: Aider
agents.notes: Git-native pair programmer; works with free models.

agents.name: Gemini CLI
agents.notes: Long context and free tier, but Google sign-up is blocked from Iran.

agents.name: Qwen Code
agents.notes: Coding CLI tuned for Qwen coder models.

agents.name: Browser Use
agents.notes: Real browser control for agents; installed here as a plugin.

agents.name: MetaMuse
agents.notes: Named by the owner; not identified yet — needs a link.
